title: MOB AG Wash
agency: DEPT OF DEFENSE > DEPT OF THE ARMY > NGB > W7MX USPFO ACTIVITY CA ARNG
description:
The Government requires professional agricultural wash and post-wash disinfection services to remove soil, vegetation, grease, grime, organic matter, pests, and other surface contaminants from military equipment. The work must prepare the equipment for Government inspection and movement while preventing cross-contamination between dirty and cleaned items. 

  

 Please email the POC if your company is able to provide the services requested.
